'''Manda''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Manda [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends#Types of stars|main-sequence star]] of [[Manda Prime]]<ref name="TEAix-x" /> in the [[Manda system/Legends|Manda system]]. The world was located at [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] coordinates R-15<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], close to that region's border with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the conclusion of the [[New Sith Wars]], Manda was located near the border of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and the planet still remained in that relative position during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Manda was a part of the [[Manda sector/Legends|sector of the same name]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Manda was located on the [[Manda Merchant Route/Legends|Manda Merchant Route]]&mdash;a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to the Mid Rim world of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], the planet of [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]] in the Outer Rim, and Manda's neighboring worlds of [[Boranda/Legends|Boranda]] and [[Dennaskar]]<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;and was the starting point of the only reliable [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route to the world of [[Roon/Legends|Roon]], the [[Manda-Roon Merchant Route]].<ref name="GatORW113" />

==History==
The region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Manda was explored sometime during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

Manda joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sometime between [[17,000 BBY]] and [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]. In [[11,198 BBY]], the planet was victim of the [[Twenty-Third Pius Dea Crusade]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

In [[3996 BBY]]&mdash;the last year of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]&mdash;the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]] engaged the Republic [[Republic Military/Legends|military forces]] in a [[Battle of the Manda system|battle]] on the planet following the former's [[Battle of the Both system|victory]] at Bothawui. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were victorious at Manda, and [[Battle of the Leritor system (Great Sith War)|moved on]] to the planet [[Leritor/Legends|Leritor]].<ref name="TEA" />

No military actions were carried out in the vicinity of Manda during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. However, in the subsequent [[Jedi Civil War]], the Republic military moved through Manda on their way from Leritor to the planet of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] as part of Republic campaign against [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

Between [[1004 BBY|1004]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], Manda was part of the Sith Space&mdash;the galactic regions under the control of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], a Sith [[Army/Legends|army]] fighting the Republic during the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point before [[520 BBY/Legends|520 BBY]], the [[Baobab Archives]] were established on the planet, and in that year, the [[Ark of Baron Auletphant]]&mdash;a legendary [[Freighter/Legends|barge]] and one of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]] that was lost in space for ten millennia&mdash;became part of the Archives.<ref name="TEA" />

Centuries later, during [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprenticeship]] to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the latter employed a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for transportation from [[Manda spaceport]] to<ref name="Dangerous Games" /> the [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="TEA" /> of [[Circarpous Major]].<ref name="Dangerous Games" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Manda was loyal to the Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] dominance over the galaxy, [[Crix Q5 Baobab]] taught young Merchant Fleet [[Officer/Legends|officers]] at the [[Baobab Merchant Marine Academy]].<ref name="TEAix-x" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|I'm, I'm -- I forget how old. When was the Trade Federation War? I retired not long after that. Retired to Manda with my wife, Pookie, and we had a miniature bantha named Nuke.|Ebenn Q3 Baobab|<ref name="EQB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Ebenn Q3 Baobab|Naboo}}</ref>}}
Around the year [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Manda's population numbered from 1 to 10 billion.<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the wealthy [[Baobab family]], a group of merchants. The [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]] employed many species, and the [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]] language was developed for interspecies communication within the Fleet. The [[Baobab Merchant Council]] also operated from Manda.

Notable natives of the planet included [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]], [[Pookie Baobab]], [[Mungo Baobab]],<ref name="CSWEMungo">{{CSWECite|I|60|Baobab, Mungo}}</ref> [[Oggem Baobab|Oggem "Old Ogger" Baobab]], and presumably [[Yperio Baobab]]. It was also home to Rebel Alliance pilot [[Adam Swiftgale]].

==Behind the scenes==
Manda first appeared in ''[[Tail of the Roon Comets]]'', the tenth episode of the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars Droids'']] animated television series, which originally aired on [[ABC Television Network|ABC]] on [[November 9]], [[1985]].
